method.label: Full-resolution deterministic Palette-256
method.implementation: Deterministic 256-color indexed PNG, no dithering, at the admitted plate's full spatial resolution.

includes: All typography rendered inside the plate, including font size, weight, spacing, legibility, and collisions.
Paths, lines, nodes, jewels, arrows, endpoints, seams, and other internal relational geometry.
Internal negative space, crop integrity, clipping, and whether labels remain attached to their intended objects.
Color and tonal distinctions, background smoothness, banding, posterization, and other encoding-visible changes.
Whether the plate preserves the same relational proposition and visual hierarchy as its accepted baseline.
excluded_from_component_probe_judgment: Whether the complete page feels like the final retail composition.
review_zone.separate_gate: Figure/caption/link adjacency and full-page composition may be reviewed separately when the integrated publication is tested.

human_review.note: Jules Gravity Palette-256 is visually equivalent to the RGB baseline locally and remains legible and relationally intact in Kindle Previewer. Thin paths, jewel, labels, and quiet field all survive. Surrounding page composition was not evaluated in this component probe.
